_comment: SPEC N5 / D4. Every *.component.ts under src/app/components/** that is NOT in design-registry.ts must be listed here with a one-line reason. Keys are paths relative to src/app/components/. scripts/check-design-system.mjs fails if a component file is in neither this file nor the registry, or if a key here points at a deleted file. Spec (*.spec.ts) and stub (*.stub.ts) files are ignored, not excluded.
didactic/comparison.component.ts: Content-specific comparison block; deferred didactic candidate, not an initial-scope primitive.
didactic/flashcard-deck/flashcard-deck.c: One-off didactic flip-card deck embedded in a single article; content-configured, not a primitive.
didactic/framework-cards.component.ts: Content-specific card set for a particular article; not reusable.
didactic/http-request-flow/http-request-: One-off didactic diagram of an HTTP round trip; fixed geometry for a single article, not a primitive.
didactic/icon-grid.component.ts: Content-specific icon grid; deferred didactic candidate, not initial scope.
didactic/interactive-timeline/interactiv: One-off didactic click-through timeline embedded in a single article; content-configured, not a primitive.
didactic/path-resolver/path-resolver.com: One-off didactic path resolver embedded in a single article; content-configured, not a primitive.
didactic/prompt-builder/prompt-builder.c: One-off didactic prompt assembler embedded in a single article; content-configured, not a primitive.
didactic/scaling-slider/scaling-slider.c: One-off didactic growth-curve slider embedded in a single article; content-configured, not a primitive.
didactic/timeline.component.ts: Content-coupled timeline block driven by article data; not a general primitive.
frame/app-footer.component.ts: App-shell chrome (site footer), singleton; not a gallery primitive.
frame/app-header.component.ts: App-shell chrome (banner, brand, pickers, omnibar), singleton; not a gallery primitive.
frame/dev-prod-toggle.component.ts: Dev-only app-shell switch (simulated production view); not a primitive.
frame/hal-eye.component.ts: App-shell easter egg (HAL 9000 eye), singleton; decorative, not a primitive.
frame/sitemap-empty-state.component.ts: Empty state of the app-shell sitemap overlay; part of that singleton.
frame/sitemap-overlay.component.ts: App-shell sitemap dialog wired to the navigation service, singleton; not reusable.
frame/cookie-consent.component.ts: App-shell chrome (consent banner), singleton; not reusable.
frame/navigation-dropdown.component.ts: App-shell navigation, wired to the route table; not reusable.
frame/notification-bell.component.ts: App-shell chrome (notification bell), singleton; not reusable.
frame/toast-container.component.ts: App-shell chrome (toast host), singleton; not reusable.
shared/active-filter-chips.component.ts: Filter UI coupled to content-list state; page-specific, not a primitive.
shared/app-loading-overlay.component.ts: App-shell singleton loading overlay; not a gallery primitive.
shared/article.component.ts: Article-page renderer; content-coupled, not a primitive.
shared/content-filter.component.ts: Content-list filter coupled to page state; not a primitive.
shared/content-hub-template.component.ts: Whole-page hub template, not a component primitive.
shared/content-visual-snippet-source.com: Dev baker source (prod-stubbed via fileReplacements); not a gallery primitive.
Content snippet renderer coupled to snippet data; not a primitive.
shared/fab-container.component.ts: FAB layout host, app-shell wiring; not a primitive.
shared/fab-stack.component.ts: FAB layout host, app-shell wiring; not a primitive.
shared/glossary-popover.component.ts: Coupled to the glossary runtime/term lookup; not a primitive.
shared/illustration-source.component.ts: Dev baker source (prod-stubbed via fileReplacements); not a gallery primitive.
shared/illustration.component.ts: Baked-illustration renderer coupled to generated assets; not a primitive.
shared/lesson-template.component.ts: Whole-page lesson template, not a component primitive.
shared/thumbnail.component.ts: Content thumbnail bound to demo/article data; data-coupled, not generic.
